plan: 2 Kings 21:1-9; 2 Chronicles 33:1-9; 2 Kings 21:10-17; 2 Chronicles 33:10-19; 2 Kings 21:18; 2 Chronicles 33:20; 2 Kings 21:19-26; 2 Chronicles 33:21-25; 2 Kings 22:1-2; 2 Chronicles 34:1-7; Jeremiah 1:1-3, 4-19; Jeremiah 2:1-13, 14-22

readings.title: The Resurgence of Systemic Disharmony
readings.subtitle: Menashsheh Reconstructs the Altars of Ba‛al
readings.text:
[2 Kings 21:1] Menashsheh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Yerushalayim. And his mother’s name was Ḥephtsiḇah.
[2] And he did evil in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, according to the abominations of the nations whom <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> dispossessed before the children of Yisra’ěl.
[3] For he turned and built <dn>את</dn> the high places which Ḥizqiyahu his father had destroyed, and raised up slaughter-places for Ba‛al, and made an Ashěrah, as Aḥaḇ sovereign of Yisra’ěl had done, and he bowed himself to all the host of the heavens and served them.

readings.title: Defiling the Set-Apart Place
readings.subtitle: Rejecting the Covenant Guarantee and Provoking the Creator
readings.text:
[4] And he built slaughter-places in the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, of which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had said, <dq>“In Yerushalayim <dn>I</dn> put <dn>My</dn> Name.”</dq>
[5] And he built slaughter-places for all the host of the heavens in the two courtyards of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[6] And he made <dn>את</dn> his son pass through the fire, and practised magic, and used divination, and consulted spiritists and mediums. He did much evil in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to provoke <dn>Him</dn>.
[7] And he placed a carved image of Ashěrah that he had made in the House of which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had said to Daviḏ and to Shelomoh his son, <dq>“In this house and in Yerushalayim, which <dn>I</dn> have chosen out of all the tribes of Yisra’ěl, <dn>I</dn> put <dn>My</dn> Name forever,</dq>
[8] <dq>and no more shall <dn>I</dn> cause <dn>את</dn> the feet of Yisra’ěl to move from the soil which <dn>I</dn> gave their fathers – only if they guard to do according to all that <dn>I</dn> have commanded them, and according to all the Torah that <dn>My</dn> servant Mosheh commanded them.”</dq>
[9] But they did not obey, and Menashsheh led them astray to do more evil than the nations whom <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had destroyed before the children of Yisra’ěl.

readings.title: A Return to the Nations' Abominations
readings.subtitle: The Re-establishment of Destructive Friction
readings.text:
[2 Chronicles 33:1] Menashsheh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Yerushalayim.
[2] But he did evil in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, according to the abominations of the nations whom <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> dispossessed from before the children of Yisra’ěl.
[3] For again he rebuilt <dn>את</dn> the high places which Ḥizqiyahu his father had broken down, and raised up slaughter-places for the Ba‛als, and made Ashěrim, and bowed himself to all the host of the heavens and served them.

readings.title: The Valley of Hinnom
readings.subtitle: Sacrificing the Seed and Abandoning the Torah
readings.text:
[4] And he built slaughter-places in the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, of which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had said, <dq>“In Yerushalayim is <dn>My</dn> Name, forever.”</dq>
[5] And he built slaughter-places for all the host of the heavens in the two courtyards of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[6] And he made <dn>את</dn> his sons pass through the fire in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, and practised magic, and used divination and witchcraft, and consulted mediums and spiritists. He did much evil in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to provoke <dn>Him</dn>.
[7] And he placed a carved image of the idol which he had made, in the House of <dn>Elohim</dn>, of which <dn>Elohim</dn> had said to Daviḏ and to Shelomoh his son, <dq>“In this house and in Yerushalayim, which <dn>I</dn> have chosen out of all the tribes of Yisra’ěl, <dn>I</dn> put <dn>My</dn> Name forever,</dq>
[8] <dq>and no more shall <dn>I</dn> remove <dn>את</dn> the foot of Yisra’ěl from the soil which <dn>I</dn> have appointed for your fathers – only if they guard to do all that <dn>I</dn> have commanded them, according to all the Torah and the laws and the right-rulings by the hand of Mosheh.”</dq>
[9] Thus Menashsheh led <dn>את</dn> Yehuḏah and <dn>את</dn> the inhabitants of Yerushalayim astray, to do more evil than the nations whom <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had destroyed before the children of Yisra’ěl.

readings.title: Tsedek and the Measuring Line of Judgment
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH Decrees the Overthrow of Yerushalayim
readings.text:
[2 Kings 21:10] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke by <dn>His</dn> servants the prophets, saying,
[11] “Because Menashsheh sovereign of Yehuḏah has done these abominations, having done more evil than all the Amorites who were before him, and also made <dn>את</dn> Yehuḏah sin with his idols,
[12] therefore thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl, <dq>‘See, <dn>I</dn> am bringing such evil upon Yerushalayim and Yehuḏah that both ears of those who hear of it shall tingle.</dq>
[13] <dq>And <dn>I</dn> shall stretch over Yerushalayim <dn>את</dn> the measuring line of Shomeron and <dn>את</dn> the plummet of the house of Aḥaḇ, and shall wipe <dn>את</dn> Yerushalayim as one wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.</dq>
[14] <dq>And <dn>I</dn> shall forsake <dn>את</dn> the remnant of <dn>My</dn> inheritance and give them into the hand of their enemies. And they shall be for a prey and for a plunder to all their enemies,</dq>
[15] <dq>because they have done evil in <dn>My</dn> eyes, and have provoked <dn>Me</dn> since the day their fathers came out of Mitsrayim, even to this day.’ ”</dq>

readings.title: The Accumulation of Blood Guilt
readings.subtitle: The Ultimate Injustice within the City
readings.text:
[16] And also, Menashsheh shed very much innocent blood, until he had filled Yerushalayim from one end to another, besides his sin with which he made Yehuḏah sin, in doing evil in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[17] And the rest of the acts of Menashsheh, and all that he did, and the sin that he committed, are they not written in the book of the annals of the sovereigns of Yehuḏah?

readings.title: The Crucible of Baḇel
readings.subtitle: The Humiliation of Pride and the Re-establishment of Trust (Emunah)
readings.text:
[2 Chronicles 33:10] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Menashsheh and to his people, but they did not listen.
[11] Therefore <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> brought upon them the commanders of the army of the sovereign of Ashshur, who captured <dn>את</dn> Menashsheh with hooks, bound him with bronze shackles, and made him go to Baḇel.
[12] And when he was in distress, he sought <dn>את</dn> the face of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> his <dn>Elohim</dn>, and humbled himself greatly before the <dn>Elohim</dn> of his fathers,
[13] and prayed to <dn>Him</dn>. And <dn>He</dn> was moved by his entreaty and heard his supplication, and brought him back to Yerushalayim into his reign. And Menashsheh knew that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was <dn>Elohim</dn>.

readings.title: Restoring the Physical and Spiritual Walls
readings.subtitle: Purging the Foreign Mighty Ones from the Mountain
readings.text:
[14] And after this he built a wall outside the City of Daviḏ on the west of Giḥon, in the wadi, and as far as the entrance of the Fish Gate, and it went round Ophel, and he made it exceedingly high. And he put army commanders in all the walled cities of Yehuḏah.
[15] And he removed <dn>את</dn> the foreign mighty ones and <dn>את</dn> the idol from the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and all the slaughter-places that he had built in the mount of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and in Yerushalayim, and he threw them out of the city.
[16] And he built <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and slaughtered slaughterings of peace offerings and thank offerings on it, and ordered Yehuḏah to serve <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl.
[17] But the people were still slaughtering on the high places, though only to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> their <dn>Elohim</dn>.

readings.title: The Record of Repentance
readings.subtitle: The Annals of a Humbled Sovereign
readings.text:
[18] And the rest of the acts of Menashsheh, his prayer to his <dn>Elohim</dn>, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl, see, they are written in the book of the sovereigns of Yisra’ěl.
[19] And his prayer, and his entreaty, and all his sin, and his trespass, and the places where he built high places and set up the Ashěrim and the carved images, before he was humbled, see, they are written among the words of the seers.

readings.title: The Death of Menashsheh
readings.subtitle: The Succession of Amon
readings.text:
[2 Kings 21:18] So Menashsheh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza. And his son Amon reigned in his place.
[2 Chronicles 33:20] So Menashsheh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house. And his son Amon reigned in his place.

readings.title: The Rejection of the Way
readings.subtitle: Amon Serves the Idols of Disharmony
readings.text:
[2 Kings 21:19] Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Yerushalayim. And the name of his mother was Meshullemeth the daughter of Ḥaruts of Yoteḇah.
[20] And he did evil in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, as his father Menashsheh had done,
[21] and walked in all the ways that his father had walked, and served <dn>את</dn> the idols that his father had served, and bowed himself to them,
[22] and forsook <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of his fathers, and did not walk in the way of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: Conspiracy from Within
readings.subtitle: The Assassination of Amon and the Rise of Yoshiyahu
readings.text:
[23] And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and killed <dn>את</dn> the sovereign in his own house.
[24] But the people of the land struck <dn>את</dn> all those who had conspired against Sovereign Amon, and the people of the land set up his son Yoshiyahu to reign in his place.
[25] And the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the sovereigns of Yehuḏah?
[26] And he was buried in his burial-place in the garden of Uzza. And his son Yoshiyahu reigned in his place.

readings.title: The Compounding Trespass
readings.subtitle: Amon's Refusal to Yield to the Master Architecture
readings.text:
[2 Chronicles 33:21] Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Yerushalayim.
[22] But he did evil in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, as his father Menashsheh had done. And Amon slaughtered to all the carved images which his father Menashsheh had made, and served them.
[23] And he did not humble himself before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, as his father Menashsheh had humbled himself, for Amon trespassed more and more.

readings.title: The People's Intervention
readings.subtitle: Striking the Conspirators and Crowning Yoshiyahu
readings.text:
[24] And his servants conspired against him, and killed him in his own house.
[25] But the people of the land struck <dn>את</dn> all those who had conspired against Sovereign Amon, and the people of the land set up his son Yoshiyahu to reign in his place.

readings.title: The Awakening of a Righteous King
readings.subtitle: Yoshiyahu Seeks the Elohim of Daviḏ
readings.text:
[2 Kings 22:1] Yoshiyahu was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Yerushalayim. And his mother’s name was Yeḏiḏah the daughter of Aḏayah of Botsqath.
[2] And he did what was right in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and walked in all the ways of his father Daviḏ, and did not turn aside, right or left.
[2 Chronicles 34:1] Yoshiyahu was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Yerushalayim.
[2] And he did what was right in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and walked in the ways of his father Daviḏ, and did not turn aside, right or left.
[3] And in the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, he began to seek the <dn>Elohim</dn> of his father Daviḏ. And in the twelfth year he began to cleanse <dn>את</dn> Yehuḏah and <dn>את</dn> Yerushalayim from the high places, and the Ashěrim, and the carved images, and the moulded images.

readings.title: Executing the Purge
readings.subtitle: Grinding the Images and Cleansing the Land of Yisra’ěl
readings.text:
[4] And they broke down <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-places of the Ba‛als in his presence, and the sun-pillars which were above them he cut down. And the Ashěrim, and the carved images, and the moulded images he smashed, and ground them up and strewed it on the surface of the burial-sites of those who had slaughtered to them.
[5] And he burned <dn>את</dn> the bones of the priests on their slaughter-places, and cleansed <dn>את</dn> Yehuḏah and <dn>את</dn> Yerushalayim,
[6] and in the cities of Menashsheh, and Ephrayim, and Shim‛on, as far as Naphtali, in their ruins all around.
[7] And he broke down <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-places and <dn>את</dn> the Ashěrim, and ground <dn>את</dn> the carved images into dust, and cut down <dn>את</dn> all the sun-pillars throughout all the land of Yisra’ěl, and returned to Yerushalayim.

readings.title: The Prophetic Commission
readings.subtitle: The Words of Yirmeyahu in the Final Days of Yehuḏah
readings.text:
[Jeremiah 1:1] The words of Yirmeyahu the son of Ḥilqiyahu, of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Binyamin,
[2] to whom the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came in the days of Yoshiyahu son of Amon, sovereign of Yehuḏah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
[3] And it came in the days of Yehoyaqim, son of Yoshiyahu, sovereign of Yehuḏah, until the end of the eleventh year of Tsiḏqiyahu, son of Yoshiyahu, sovereign of Yehuḏah, until the exile of Yerushalayim in the fifth new moon.

readings.title: Pre-Ordained Authority
readings.subtitle: Appointed as a Prophet to the Nations to Uproot and Plant
readings.text:
[Jeremiah 1:4] Now the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying,
[5] <dq>“Before <dn>I</dn> formed you in the belly <dn>I</dn> knew you, and before you came out of the womb <dn>I</dn> did set you apart – <dn>I</dn> appointed you a prophet to nations.”</dq>
[6] And said I, “Ah, Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! See, I do not know how to speak, for I am a youth.”
[7] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>“Do not say, ‘<dn>I</dn> am a youth,’ but go to all to whom <dn>I</dn> send you, and speak whatever <dn>I</dn> command you.</dq>
[8] <dq>“Do not fear their faces, for <dn>I</dn> am with you to deliver you,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[9] Then <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> put forth <dn>His</dn> hand and touched my mouth, and <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> have put <dn>My</dn> words in your mouth.</dq>
[10] <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> have this day set you over the nations and over the reigns, to root out and to pull down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”</dq>

readings.title: The Boiling Pot from the North
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH Decrees Justice Against Systemic Idolatry
readings.text:
[11] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying, “What do you see, Yirmeyahu?” And I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”
[12] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>“You have seen well, for <dn>I</dn> am watching over <dn>My</dn> word to do it.”</dq>
[13] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me a second time, saying, “What do you see?” And I said, “I see a boiling pot, and it is facing away from the north.”
[14] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to me, <dq>“Out of the north evil is set loose on all the inhabitants of the land.</dq>
[15] <dq>“For look, <dn>I</dn> am calling all the clans of the reigns of the north,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. <dq>“And they shall come and each one set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Yerushalayim, against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Yehuḏah.</dq>
[16] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall pronounce <dn>My</dn> judgments against them concerning all their evil, because they have forsaken <dn>Me</dn>, burned incense to other mighty ones, and bowed themselves to the works of their own hands.</dq>

readings.title: The Iron Column of Truth
readings.subtitle: Standing Firm Against the Retributive Systems of Men
readings.text:
[17] <dq>“Now, gird up your loins and arise, and speak to them all that <dn>I</dn> command you. Do not break down before their faces, lest <dn>I</dn> break you before them.</dq>
[18] <dq>“For look, <dn>I</dn> have made you this day a walled city and an iron column, and bronze walls against all the land, against the sovereigns of Yehuḏah, against her heads, against her priests, and against the people of the land.</dq>
[19] <dq>“And they shall fight against you, but not prevail against you. For <dn>I</dn> am with you,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“to deliver you.”</dq>

readings.title: The First-Fruits of the Covenant
readings.subtitle: Remembering the Trust (Emunah) of Yisra’ěl’s Youth
readings.text:
[Jeremiah 2:1] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to me, saying,
[2] “Go, and you shall cry in the hearing of Yerushalayim, saying, ‘Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“<dn>I</dn> remember you, the loving-commitment of your youth, the love of your bridehood, when you went after <dn>Me</dn> in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.</dq>
[3] <dq>“Yisra’ěl was set-apart to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the first-fruits of <dn>His</dn> increase. All who ate of it became guilty – evil came upon them,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.’ ”

readings.title: The Failure of the Shepherds
readings.subtitle: Forgetting the Deliverance from the Crucible of Mitsrayim
readings.text:
[4] Hear the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, O house of Ya‛aqoḇ and all the clans of the house of Yisra’ěl.
[5] Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“What unrighteousness have your fathers found in <dn>Me</dn>, that they have gone far from <dn>Me</dn>, and went after worthlessness, and became worthless?</dq>
[6] <dq>“And did not they say, ‘Where is <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, who brought us up out of <dn>את</dn> the land of Mitsrayim, who led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and pits, through a land of drought and the shadow of death, a land that no one passed through and where no one dwelt?’</dq>
[7] <dq>“Then <dn>I</dn> brought you into a garden land, to eat its fruit and its goodness. But when you entered, you defiled <dn>My</dn> land and made <dn>My</dn> inheritance an abomination.</dq>
[8] <dq>“The priests did not say, ‘Where is <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>?’ And those who handle the Torah did not know <dn>Me</dn>, and the shepherds transgressed against <dn>Me</dn>, and the prophets prophesied by Ba‛al, and walked after matters that did not profit.</dq>

readings.title: The Ultimate Indictment
readings.subtitle: Forsaking the Living Waters for Cracked, Humanistic Cisterns
readings.text:
[9] <dq>“Therefore <dn>I</dn> still contend with you,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“and with your children’s children <dn>I</dn> contend.</dq>
[10] <dq>“For, pass beyond the isles of Kittim and see, and send to Qěḏar and observe well, and see if there has been any like this.</dq>
[11] <dq>“Has a nation changed its mighty ones, which are not mighty ones? But <dn>My</dn> people have changed <dn>My</dn> esteem for that which does not profit.</dq>
[12] <dq>“Be amazed, O heavens, at this, and be frightened, be utterly dried up,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[13] <dq>“For <dn>My</dn> people have done two evils: they have forsaken <dn>Me</dn>, the fountain of living waters, to hew out for themselves cisterns, cracked cisterns, which do not hold water.</dq>

readings.title: The Bitter Fruit of Geopolitical Alliances
readings.subtitle: Seeking Security in the Waters of Mitsrayim and Ashshur
readings.text:
[Jeremiah 2:14] “Is Yisra’ěl a servant? Was he born in the house? Why is he given to plunder?
[15] “The young lions roared at him, they growled, and made his land waste; his cities have been burned, without inhabitant.
[16] “Even the sons of Noph and of Taḥpanḥes have shaven the crown of your head.
[17] “Have you not done this to yourself, by forsaking <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> when <dn>He</dn> led you in the way?
[18] “And now why take <dn>את</dn> the way to Mitsrayim, to drink the waters of Shiḥor? Or why take <dn>את</dn> the way to Ashshur, to drink the waters of the River?
[19] “Your own evil instructs you, and your backslidings reprove you. Know therefore and see that it is evil and bitter that you have forsaken <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, and that <dn>My</dn> fear is not in you,” declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts.

readings.title: The Degenerate Vine
readings.subtitle: The Illusion of Cleansing an Unguarded Heart
readings.text:
[20] <dq>“For of old <dn>I</dn> have broken <dn>את</dn> your yoke and torn off <dn>את</dn> your chastisements. And you said, ‘<dn>I</dn> am not serving You,’ when on every high hill and under every green tree you lay down, a whore.</dq>
[21] <dq>“Yet <dn>I</dn> had planted you a choice vine, all of it a true seed. How then have you turned before <dn>Me</dn> into the degenerate plant of a strange vine?</dq>
[22] <dq>“Although you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, yet your crookedness is ingrained before <dn>Me</dn>,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
